description: A complete input. Every statement is written and the skill does not over-ask: at most the coverage-gap question and real ambiguities (whether "every export" includes rejected ones, and which instant "the export time" is).

must_match.pattern: ^REQ-\d+: (While [^\n]*, when|When) an admin clicks "Export CSV" on the Reports page, the export service shall [^\n]*within 5 minutes of the click
must_match.why: the event-driven statement keeps the input's terms and its starting point

must_match.pattern: ^REQ-\d+: If [^\n]*more than 100,000 rows, then the export service shall reject the export and display "Report too large to export"\.
must_match.why: the unwanted case uses If ... then with the exact message

must_match.pattern: ^REQ-\d+: Where the audit module is installed, [^\n]*the export service shall log
must_match.why: an installed module is a feature, so Where

must_not_match.why: asked for a value the input already gives

manual: Each question asks about the evident failure case (the email cannot be delivered) or a real ambiguity in the input, not a value the input gives.
